characters.label: Recurring finance and economics presenter
characters.prompt: Original fictional Black male finance presenter in his thirties with warm brown skin, short sculpted loc twists and a clean taper, black rectangular glasses, a neatly trimmed goatee, tailored deep-indigo suit, pale blue shirt, copper tie, restrained gold circuit lapel pin, and brown cap-toe dress shoes with a subtle handcrafted red-and-gold Spanish floral textile. Sophisticated adult hand-cut crinkle-paper woodblock editorial puppet with consistent proportions, friendly analytical expression, clean trace-cut silhouette, and fully visible hands and feet.
characters.negative_prompt: No photorealism, celebrity likeness, toy proportions, childish styling, extra fingers, malformed hands, cropped feet, floating props, generated words, numbers, charts, logos, currency symbols, or watermarks.
